notes.title: Surprise! LumbearJack is OUT NOW!
notes.notes:
[h2]Hey there, LumbearJack fans! [/h2]

If you didn't hear the news, Jack swung by today's Wholesome Direct to announce that [u][b]LumbearJack is OUT RIGHT NOW![/b][/u] We're so excited about this announcement and hope you are too. Here's our brand-new release trailer to celebrate:

[previewyoutube=1Od__d810Hg;full][/previewyoutube]

Also, on a related note, we're so proud to say our game has partnered with Ecologi in their mission to save the world one tree at a time! For every copy of LumbearJack we sell, Ecologi will plant a tree in order to help sustain our planet's forests. [b][url=https://ecologi.com/jackslumbearforest]Check out the official LumbearJack page on their website to learn more![/url][/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41036348/95bd765ccf8c33ca0c80b20a1ece8d226a49a4e8.gif[/img]

That's it from us for now. Thank you so much for supporting us on the road to launch--whether you played the Next Fest demo, added LumbearJack to your wishlist, or even just checked out our Steam page, we appreciate you all so much.

[h3]Play LumbearJack now:[/h3]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1582290/LumbearJack/
